messages:
alex_g: Hi — trying to redeem a promo but it's being rejected as invalid/expired. Code: REDWOODFRIEND. Tried in dashboard and via API. Email alex@goodco.com. Screenshot attached.

maria_s: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact error you see from the API (response body) and whether you used the dashboard flow or the curl/SDK? Also which org are you in (org id or the invited company name)?

alex_g: Dashboard + API both. API response: ```{\n  \"error\": \"coupon_rejected\",\n  \"reason\": \"invalid_or_expired\",\n  \"status\": 410\n}```
I used the curl flow:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/redeem \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"code":"REDWOODFRIEND","account_email":"alex@goodco.com"}'
```
Our org name is "GoodCo" — not sure of the numeric id, email is primary.

maria_s: Thanks. I'm pinging billing-bot to check the promo metadata and any org scoping.

billing-bot: promo_lookup: code=REDWOODFRIEND -> status=active, scope=org_scoped, granted_org=org_12345, expires=2026-06-01, redeemed=false
Note: requester's current_account_org=org_67890

kevin_eng: Looking at billing logs — the promo is indeed org-scoped to org_12345. It appears GoodCo recently merged accounts (org_12345 -> org_67890). Our redemption path currently validates against the request's current org id and doesn't consult historical grants from merged orgs. That's why API returns invalid_or_expired while the dashboard (sometimes) shows it as available due to cache.

lily_support: Repro steps for internal tracking:
1) Create promo scoped to org A (org_12345)
2) Merge org A into org B (org_67890)
3) Attempt redemption using account now in org B => API returns 410 invalid_or_expired

kevin_eng: Fix plan: allow redemption if promo.granted_org == user.prev_org_id OR map merged_orgs via org_merge table. Quick patch to billing-service to check org_merge for the next deploy. I'll open BILL-721 and target the hotfix for the next rollout (in ~30m).

maria_s: In the meantime I applied the trial credit manually: +1500 tokens to alex@goodco.com (internal credit id: manual_credit_SUP-8432). You should see it on your usage page in a minute. :white_check_mark:

alex_g: I can confirm the credit showed up, trying a call now. Thanks so much!

alex_g: Confirmed — generate works and trial credits applied. Really appreciate the quick help. :tada:

maria_s: Great. I've documented steps and assigned the bug BILL-721 to kevin_eng. I'll follow up once the hotfix is deployed. Closing the thread for now. If anything else pops up, reopen or ping support.

kevin_eng: FYI the hotfix rolled out in staging, will promote to prod in the next deploy window. Ticket: BILL-721.

maria_s: Closing — resolved.
